_README: Risk-Management input for beyond-shor.eu — consumed by `shorsight govern`.
The asset key is the SOURCE LABEL as ShorSight reports it ('beyond-shor'), NOT
'beyond-shor (local)' — the '(local)' suffix is the source *kind* and is not part of
the key. A mismatched key is silently ignored: owner, security objectives, economic
damage and treatments are then all dropped and every impact stays 'provisional'.
shelfLifeYears = X (how long the data must stay confidential), migrationYears = Y.

beyond-shor :: X25519.note: Deliberate: X25519 is the classical half of the hybrid handshake and is paired with ML-KEM-1024.

beyond-shor :: EC-P256.note: ECDSA P-256 is kept as the classical reference point in the signature benchmark.
